Package com.kerosene.kfe.messaging.adapters.out.websocket

Class BalanceUpdateEvent

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.messaging.adapters.out.websocket.BalanceUpdateEvent
public class BalanceUpdateEvent extends Object
Realtime balance snapshot. Legacy clients only read newBalance/amount/context. New fields enable dual-ledger UIs (available vs observed) without overwriting the wrong bucket.

  • Constructor Details

    • BalanceUpdateEvent

      public BalanceUpdateEvent(String walletId, String walletName, Long userId, BigDecimal newBalance, BigDecimal amount, String context)
      Creates the legacy-compatible scalar balance event and stamps its creation time in UTC.
      Parameters:
      walletId - stable wallet identifier
      walletName - display label for the wallet
      userId - wallet owner's identifier
      newBalance - legacy aggregate balance after the mutation
      amount - legacy mutation amount
      context - business context or mutation origin

    • BalanceUpdateEvent

      public BalanceUpdateEvent(String walletId, String walletName, Long userId, BigDecimal newBalance, BigDecimal amount, String context, String kind, Long availableSats, Long lockedSats, Long pendingSats, Long observedSats, Long primarySats, String bucket)
      Creates a balance event with both legacy scalar values and explicit ledger bucket snapshots. Delegates common identity/time initialization to the legacy constructor.
      Parameters:
      walletId - stable wallet identifier
      walletName - display label for the wallet
      userId - wallet owner's identifier
      newBalance - legacy aggregate balance after the mutation
      amount - legacy mutation amount
      context - business context or mutation origin
      kind - wallet classification controlling how clients interpret its balances
      availableSats - spendable amount after the mutation, in satoshis
      lockedSats - reserved or locked amount in satoshis
      pendingSats - unsettled amount in satoshis
      observedSats - chain-observed amount in satoshis
      primarySats - amount clients should emphasize for this wallet kind
      bucket - principal balance bucket changed by the mutation
